description: Original dialogue probes frozen before production experiments. No human listening labels.

cases.text: 指挥官，请关闭左侧的舱门。
cases.speaker: Vivian

cases.text: 不要启动引擎，燃料管还没有接好。
cases.speaker: Uncle_Fu

cases.text: 三号闸门将在十秒后开启。
cases.speaker: Dylan

cases.text: 收到，我会在这里等你回来。
cases.speaker: Serena

cases.text: Stay close. The path becomes narrow after the bridge.
cases.speaker: Ryan

cases.text: Do not touch the red crystal. It is still unstable.
cases.speaker: Aiden

cases.text: We found the missing map under the old wooden table.
cases.speaker: Ryan

cases.text: I thought the forest would remember us.
cases.speaker: Aiden

cases.text: 灯塔已经熄灭，所有船只立刻返航。
cases.speaker: Vivian

cases.text: 这不是敌人的信号，先别开火。
cases.speaker: Uncle_Fu

cases.text: 北边还有两艘船，我们不能丢下他们。
cases.speaker: Dylan

cases.text: 风停以后，我们一起去看海。
cases.speaker: Serena

cases.text: The second bell will ring before the tower door closes.
cases.speaker: Ryan

cases.text: Do not turn the silver key until I give the signal.
cases.speaker: Aiden

cases.text: At last, the little clock is working again.
cases.speaker: Ryan

cases.text: We promised to keep this place safe.
cases.speaker: Aiden
